UID: Summon_TotemFromSurface

Elemental Totem is a Summoning skill.

Description

[edit | edit source]

Elemental Totem will summon an uncontrollable totem minion onto the battlefield for the player and depending on the field they summon it on it will change accordingly, if not summoned onto any specific field it will be a generic Wood Totem that does physical damage.

Variants
  • Fire Totem - Fires small fireballs, causes burning and can ignite oil and poison fields.
  • Water Totem - Fires bolts of water, causes wet.
  • Oil Totem - Fires oil, causes slowed.
  • Electric Totem - Fires lightning, can cause puddles to become stun fields.
  • Poison Totem - Fires poison bolts.
  • Blood Totem - Fires blood balls.

Since Elemental Totem relies on Summoning magic it cannot be cast if caster is affected by File:Silenced.png Silenced and File:Enraged.png Enraged status effects.
